cc:Work.dc:description: A six-panel reference card shows healthy convergence, overfitting, slow undertraining, flat collapse, instability and suspiciously perfect results. Each uses solid training and dashed validation curves.

g.text: Read the curve. Then check the metric.

g.text: A flat loss is not automatically a useful model. A near-perfect metric is not automatically a valid test.
